newsitem.title: USA: Associates First unit to sell senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Associates First unit to sell senior notes.

text.p: Associates Corp of North America, a unit of Associates First Capital Corp, said on Thursday it agreed to sell $400 million of 6.680 percent senior notes due Sept 17, 1999.
The company said in a statement that the notes would be offered to the public at par to yield 6.680 percent through Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
The notes were registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Net proceeds from the sale of the securities will be applied at first to the reduction of commercial paper borrowings.
Associates First is an indirect, majority-owned subsidiary of Ford Motor Co.
